name: Malawi
summary: Black, red and green horizontal bands with a red rising sun of 31 rays in the black band. Adopted at independence in 1964, it was briefly replaced in 2010–2012 by a version with a full white sun.
origin: Nyasaland became independent as Malawi on 6 July 1964. The flag was based on the colours of the Malawi Congress Party, led by Hastings Banda.

In 2010 President Bingu wa Mutharika changed the flag to red, black and green with a full white sun, saying Malawi had already 'risen'. The change was unpopular, and parliament restored the original in 2012.

colors.name: Red
colors.meaning: The blood of martyrs of African freedom.

symbols.name: Rising sun
symbols.description: A red half-sun with 31 rays in the black band.
symbols.meaning: The dawn of hope and freedom for Africa; Malawi was the 31st African country to become independent.

history.label: Mutharika's flag
history.note: Full white sun in the centre.

facts: Biafra's 1967 flag also had a rising sun in a black band of a red-black-green tricolour.
Its colours are those of Marcus Garvey's UNIA flag.
clues: Black, red and green bands with a red rising sun in the black band.
It was changed to a full white sun in 2010 and changed back in 2012.
